description: This is a PHP source file for the web UI of a network device, specifically the 'Add Dynamic DNS' page. It contains server-side PHP code mixed with embedded HTML and JavaScript, responsible for rendering the page, handling user input validation, dynamic UI interactions, and AJAX requests to add a new Dynamic DNS entry.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Dynamically adds a new Host Name input field in the form when the 'ADD' button is clicked.

methods.name: add1
methods.description: Removes a Host Name input field when the 'Remove' button is clicked.
